title: GCLI-12b: code-map tier 3, symbols resolved through the index, with dedupe and displacement
description: Child of GCLI-12, split confirmed by the leader on 2026-11-17 after the worker's size read (the whole is well over the ~400-line ceiling). Builds to opum-doc DEC-216 (a4) and opum-cli's CodeMapProducer seam (opum-ai/opum-cli dev, src/context/code-map.ts, and ADR 0008), read by ref only. NOT STARTED: 12a's shape depends on opum-doc's ruling on port-versus-merge (Q1), pending. Slice b of three, after 12a: tier 3 per DEC-216 (a4). Symbols named in the task text, resolved through the index to their declaring files (score 0), plus the depth-1 impact of those symbols (score 1). Tier order is named paths, changed files, glyph, git-grep identifiers; a file in several tiers keeps its highest tier; ties break by score then path. The task-text-to-symbol-name rule (Q2) is pending opum-doc.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A task naming a symbol imported through an alias, which grep misses, finds its file in tier 3.
A file in more than one tier appears once at its highest tier; a mutation dropping the tier dedupe makes exactly the multi-tier file appear twice.
A fixture where tier 3 displaces a grep-only file at the 20-file cap records the displaced file under omissions.
With glyph disabled the output is the tiers 1, 2 and 4 output unchanged; bun run check passes.
